description: Make a pane the active pane of its window, optionally zooming the window on it (zoom: true, like tmux's prefix z) or unzooming it (zoom: false); without zoom the window keeps its zoom state. Like tmux itself, every client looking at that window follows, your terminal included. It does not change the session's current window (tmux::windows::select does).

zoom.description: true zooms the window on this pane, false unzooms it, absent keeps the window's zoom.

pane_id.description: Pane id now active in its window.

session_id.description: Session id the pane was resolved in.

zoomed.description: The window is zoomed on the active pane.
